body_html:
Lead generation for Tequesta businesses

Tequesta is a small market, which cuts both ways: there are fewer customers to reach, so you can't afford to miss the ones who are searching. A scattershot marketing budget burns fast here. We focus lead generation tightly on the people in Tequesta and the surrounding north county who are actually looking for your service right now.

Precise targeting, real booked work — not wasted spend.

How we generate leads

  • Local SEO — service-and-city pages and Google Business Profile optimization to own the local searches that matter.
  • Paid ads — tightly geo-targeted Google and Meta campaigns so every dollar reaches your actual area.
  • Conversion funnels — landing pages and follow-up that turn interest into booked appointments.
  • Tracking — call and form tracking so you know what works and what each lead costs.

Built around your real service area

In a small market, precision is everything — we target the exact cities and services you want more of, and cut the rest.

Serving Tequesta and the north county

We work with businesses across Tequesta, Jupiter, Juno Beach, Palm Beach Gardens, and North Palm Beach — and extend through Palm Beach County as you grow.

faq.q: Is there enough search volume in a small town like Tequesta?
faq.a: Often the smarter play is targeting Tequesta plus the surrounding north county — that's how you get enough qualified volume without paying for searches outside your area.

faq.q: How do I know the leads are real?
faq.a: We set up call and form tracking so you see every lead, its source, and its cost.

faq.q: Which businesses does this work for?
faq.a: Local service businesses and owner-operators that earn from nearby customers actively searching for what they offer.
